title: Where Database Lab lives and what it may change
summary: Architecture: Tom Dyer; code: ChatGPT (GPT-6). The Database Lab is an ooRexx OodDatabaseLab model on Alchemy NoSQLServer (immutable package packages/oorexx_oodialog_database_lab_v0.1.2 in animatedads/alchemy). It creates disposable databases, creates and drops tables, replaces only genuinely empty unreferenced tables and executes SQL; unsupported ALTER TABLE is not emulated for populated data. Its separate ooRexx/WASM session avoids loading NoSQLServer classes into the Designer's code/reflection session. Page files live under oodialog-designer/site/database-lab.js and .css in animatedads/oorexx, with db.* English and German resources in src/OodUi.cls and dependency staging in tools/database.rex. The SVG Graph tab was pushed on feature/oodialog-database-graph-v3-20261115 at commit a001470dfcabe82859cb84732e5cc406ed6615c7, based on Designer v0.11 b6a6287. Avoid production databases and credentials: this is a disposable test facility.
invariants: ooRexx/NoSQLServer owns schema, database and data decisions; JavaScript does not implement SQL or parse SQL into a schema.
The Database Lab runs in a separate WASM session from Designer.
Never replace a populated table; empty-table replacement is not a transactional migration.
Use an immutable Alchemy package version and an Autobuild integration manifest for model changes.
Each class has module_version and module_lastChanged on class and instance sides; attribute Architecture: Tom Dyer and Code: ChatGPT (GPT-6).
